<?php
fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $n, $m);
$grid = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    $line = trim(fgets(STDIN));
    if ($line === '') { $i--; continue; }
    $row = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', $line));
    $grid[$i] = $row;
}

$pairPos = []; // value => [ [r1,c1], [r2,c2] ]
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    for ($j = 0; $j < $m; $j++) {
        $v = $grid[$i][$j];
        if (!isset($pairPos[$v])) $pairPos[$v] = [];
        $pairPos[$v][] = [$i, $j];
    }
}

$N = $n * $m;
$INF = 1e18;

// Precompute adjacency list for grid graph
$adj = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    for ($j = 0; $j < $m; $j++) {
        $id = $i * $m + $j;
        $adj[$id] = [];
        if ($i > 0) $adj[$id][] = ($i - 1) * $m + $j;
        if ($i + 1 < $n) $adj[$id][] = ($i + 1) * $m + $j;
        if ($j > 0) $adj[$id][] = $i * $m + ($j - 1);
        if ($j + 1 < $m) $adj[$id][] = $i * $m + ($j + 1);
    }
}

// Hungarian algorithm for minimum weight perfect matching on complete bipartite graph
function hungarian($cost) {
    $n = count($cost) - 1; // 1-based
    $u = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
    $v = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
    $p = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
    $way = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);

    for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
        $p[0] = $i;
        $minv = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 1e18);
        $used = array_fill(0, $n + 1, false);
        $j0 = 0;
        do {
            $used[$j0] = true;
            $i0 = $p[$j0];
            $delta = 1e18;
            $j1 = 0;
            for ($j = 1; $j <= $n; $j++) {
                if (!$used[$j]) {
                    $cur = $cost[$i0][$j] - $u[$i0] - $v[$j];
                    if ($cur < $minv[$j]) {
                        $minv[$j] = $cur;
                        $way[$j] = $j0;
                    }
                    if ($minv[$j] < $delta) {
                        $delta = $minv[$j];
                        $j1 = $j;
                    }
                }
            }
            for ($j = 0; $j <= $n; $j++) {
                if ($used[$j]) {
                    $u[$p[$j]] += $delta;
                    $v[$j] -= $delta;
                } else {
                    $minv[$j] -= $delta;
                }
            }
            $j0 = $j1;
        } while ($p[$j0] != 0);
        do {
            $j1 = $way[$j0];
            $p[$j0] = $p[$j1];
            $j0 = $j1;
        } while ($j0 != 0);
    }

    $match = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
    for ($j = 1; $j <= $n; $j++) {
        $match[$p[$j]] = $j;
    }
    $value = -$v[0];
    return [$value, $match];
}

// Build cost matrix between pairs and edges
$pairs = array_values($pairPos);
$pairCount = count($pairs);
$edges = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    for ($j = 0; $j < $m; $j++) {
        $id = $i * $m + $j;
        foreach ($adj[$id] as $nid) {
            if ($nid > $id) $edges[] = [$id, $nid];
        }
    }
}
$edgeCount = count($edges);

// cost matrix is pairCount x edgeCount (must be square for Hungarian)
// If pairCount != edgeCount, we need to pad with dummy nodes
$size = max($pairCount, $edgeCount);
$cost = array_fill(0, $size + 1, array_fill(0, $size + 1, 0));

for ($i = 0; $i < $pairCount; $i++) {
    $p = $pairs[$i];
    $r1 = $p[0][0]; $c1 = $p[0][1];
    $r2 = $p[1][0]; $c2 = $p[1][1];
    $id1 = $r1 * $m + $c1;
    $id2 = $r2 * $m + $c2;
    for ($e = 0; $e < $edgeCount; $e++) {
        $a = $edges[$e][0];
        $b = $edges[$e][1];
        // compute cost: number of shoes moved = 2 - (# of endpoints already occupied by this pair)
        $cnt = 0;
        if ($a == $id1 || $a == $id2) $cnt++;
        if ($b == $id1 || $b == $id2) $cnt++;
        $moves = 2 - $cnt;
        $cost[$i+1][$e+1] = $moves;
    }
    // pad remaining columns (if any) with 2 (max moves)
    for ($e = $edgeCount; $e < $size; $e++) {
        $cost[$i+1][$e+1] = 2;
    }
}
// pad remaining rows with zeros
for ($i = $pairCount; $i < $size; $i++) {
    for ($e = 0; $e < $size; $e++) {
        $cost[$i+1][$e+1] = 0;
    }
}

list($minCost, $match) = hungarian($cost);

// total moved shoes is minCost
echo $minCost . PHP_EOL;
?>

$leftIndex = [];  // [i][j] => left id
$rightIndex = []; // [i][j] => right id
$L = 0; $R = 0;

        }
    }
}

// For each pair, if its two cells are adjacent (Manhattan distance 1),
// add an edge between corresponding left and right nodes.
foreach ($pos as $pair => $cells) {
    list($r1, $c1) = $cells[0];
    list($r2, $c2) = $cells[1];

            $v = $rightIndex[$r2][$c2];
        } else {
            $u = $leftIndex[$r2][$c2];
            $v = $rightIndex[$r1][$c1];
        }
        $adj[$u][] = $v;
    }
}

$pairV = array_fill(0, $R, -1);
$distArr = array_fill(0, $L, 0);

$INF = 1 << 30;

    $queue = [];
    for ($u = 0; $u < $L; $u++) {
        if ($pairU[$u] == -1) {

            $queue[] = $u;

                $queue[] = $pu;

            $pairV[$v] = $u;

    }
}

// Precompute parity of each cell (0 for black, 1 for white)
$parity = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    for ($j = 0; $j < $m; $j++) {
        $parity[$i][$j] = ($i + $j) & 1;
    }
}

// Build bipartite graph: black cells -> white cells
// Each shoe pair gives an edge between its two cells
$adj = []; // adjacency list from black index to list of white indices
$blackIndex = [];
$whiteIndex = [];

$whiteCount = 0;

// Assign indices to black and white cells
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    for ($j = 0; $j < $m; $j++) {
        if ($parity[$i][$j] == 0) {
            $blackIndex[$i][$j] = $blackCount++;
        } else {
            $whiteIndex[$i][$j] = $whiteCount++;
        }
    }
}

// Initialize adjacency
for ($i = 0; $i < $blackCount; $i++) $adj[$i] = [];

// For each shoe pair, add edge between its two cells
foreach ($pos as $pair) {
    list($p1, $p2) = $pair;
    $i1 = $p1[0]; $j1 = $p1[1];
    $i2 = $p2[0]; $j2 = $p2[1];
    if ($parity[$i1][$j1] == 0) {
        $u = $blackIndex[$i1][$j1];
        $v = $whiteIndex[$i2][$j2];
    } else {
        $u = $blackIndex[$i2][$j2];
        $v = $whiteIndex[$i1][$j1];
    }
    $adj[$u][] = $v;
}

// Hopcroft-Karp algorithm for maximum matching
$pairU = array_fill(0, $blackCount, -1);
$pairV = array_fill(0, $whiteCount, -1);
$dist = array_fill(0, $blackCount, 0);

$INF = 1 << 30;

    $qHead = 0;
    $queue = [];
    for ($u = 0; $u < $blackCount; $u++) {
        if ($pairU[$u] == -1) {
            $dist[$u] = 0;
            $queue[] = $u;
        } else {
            $dist[$u] = $INF;
        }
    }
    $found = false;
    while ($qHead < count($queue)) {
        $u = $queue[$qHead++];
        foreach ($adj[$u] as $v) {
            $pu = $pairV[$v];
            if ($pu != -1 && $dist[$pu] == $INF) {
                $dist[$pu] = $dist[$u] + 1;
                $queue[] = $pu;
            }
            if ($pu == -1) {
                $found = true;
            }
        }
    }
    return $found;
};

$DFS = function($u) use (&$pairU, &$pairV, &$dist, &$adj, $INF, &$DFS) {
    foreach ($adj[$u] as $v) {
        $pu = $pairV[$v];
        if ($pu == -1 || ($dist[$pu] == $dist[$u] + 1 && $DFS($pu))) {
            $pairU[$u] = $v;
            $pairV[$v] = $u;
            return true;
        }
    }
    $dist[$u] = $INF;
    return false;

$matching = 0;

    for ($u = 0; $u < $blackCount; $u++) {
        if ($pairU[$u] == -1) {
            if ($DFS($u)) $matching++;
        }
    }

// Maximum matching size is matching
// Minimum vertex cover size equals matching (Kőnig's theorem)

fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $n, $m);

for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    $line = trim(fgets(STDIN));
    $row = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', $line));

$totalCells = $n * $m;
$pairCount = $totalCells / 2;

$pos = array_fill(0, $pairCount + 1, []);
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    for ($j = 0; $j < $m; $j++) {
        $id = $grid[$i][$j];
        $pos[$id][] = [$i, $j];
    }
}

// check if already adjacent
function is_adjacent($a, $b) {
    return abs($a[0] - $b[0]) + abs($a[1] - $b[1]) == 1;
}

$alreadyAdj = 0;
for ($id = 1; $id <= $pairCount; $id++) {
    if (is_adjacent($pos[$id][0], $pos[$id][1])) $alreadyAdj++;
}

// build bipartite graph: left = black cells, right = white cells
// color by (i+j)%2
$leftIndex = [];
$rightIndex = [];
$leftCount = 0;
$rightCount = 0;
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    for ($j = 0; $j < $m; $j++) {
        if ((($i + $j) & 1) == 0) {
            $leftIndex[$i][$j] = $leftCount++;
        } else {
            $rightIndex[$i][$j] = $rightCount++;
        }
    }
}

// adjacency list for left side
$adj = array_fill(0, $leftCount, []);
$dirs = [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]];
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    for ($j = 0; $j < $m; $j++) {
        if ((($i + $j) & 1) != 0) continue;
        $u = $leftIndex[$i][$j];
        foreach ($dirs as $d) {
            $ni = $i + $d[0];
            $nj = $j + $d[1];
            if ($ni < 0 || $ni >= $n || $nj < 0 || $nj >= $m) continue;
            $v = $rightIndex[$ni][$nj];
            $adj[$u][] = $v;
        }
    }
}

// Hopcroft-Karp
$pairU = array_fill(0, $leftCount, -1);
$pairV = array_fill(0, $rightCount, -1);
$dist = array_fill(0, $leftCount, 0);

function bfsHK($adj, &$pairU, &$pairV, &$dist, $leftCount) {
    $queue = [];
    $front = 0;
    $INF = 1 << 30;
    for ($u = 0; $u < $leftCount; $u++) {
        if ($pairU[$u] == -1) {
            $dist[$u] = 0;
            $queue[] = $u;
        } else {
            $dist[$u] = $INF;
        }
    }
    $found = false;
    while ($front < count($queue)) {
        $u = $queue[$front++];
        foreach ($adj[$u] as $v) {
            $pu = $pairV[$v];
            if ($pu != -1 && $dist[$pu] == $INF) {
                $dist[$pu] = $dist[$u] + 1;
                $queue[] = $pu;
            }
            if ($pu == -1) {
                $found = true;
            }
        }
    }
